note: sync_warehouse_export(workspace, destination, export) against a scripted pinned_get. request: POST url, headers (Content-Type application/x-ndjson, Idempotency-Key warehouse:<destination>:<run>, <header_name or Authorization>: secret), timeout 30.0, streamed body (= manifest line + records; sha256/bytes/first line recorded). success summary 'exported N rows; sha256=<first 12 of records_sha256>'; external_id: x-job-id, else location, else json job_id, else json id (str), None when none/invalid. Non-2xx: 'warehouse HTTP <code>: <text[:300]>'. The secret value appears only as {{secret:WAREHOUSE_AUTH}}.
